description: This file implements the <request-parameters-to-list> element for the MiniLang language within the Ofbiz framework. It processes HTTP request parameters and populates a list in the method context, facilitating parameter handling during method execution.

classes.name: RequestParametersToList
classes.description: Implements the <request-parameters-to-list> MiniLang element, converting specified request parameters into a list within the method execution context.

methods.name: autoCorrect
methods.description: Corrects deprecated attributes in the XML element during construction, specifically replacing 'list-name' with 'list'.

methods.name: RequestParametersToList
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation, validating attributes and setting up expression and accessor objects.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation, retrieving request parameters and appending them to a list in the method context environment map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the element for debugging or logging.
